subject: a blacksmith's workshop in a fantasy medieval town
scene: Camera at standing eye level in the middle of a cluttered stone and timber workshop. A glowing brick forge with orange coals and a bellows on one side, a heavy anvil on a wooden block, a quenching trough, racks and shelves crowded with hammers, tongs, horseshoes, half-finished blades and iron bar stock, a workbench with a vice, sparks and warm firelight, a wide doorway open onto the alley, soot-darkened beams above.
